mapper.sql: select n.id, n.user_id, n.category_id, n.title, n.filename, n.markdown_content, n.word_count, n.tags, n.is_public, n.status, n.sort_order, n.public_section_id, n.create_time, n.update_time, u.nick_name as author_name, u.avatar, s.name as section_name from note n left join sys_user u on n.user_id = u.user_id left join note_public_section s on n.public_section_id = s.id

mapper.select:
SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.category_id, n.title, n.filename, n.markdown_content, n.word_count, n.tags, n.is_public, n.status, n.sort_order, n.create_time, n.update_time, u.nick_name as author_name, u.avatar, COALESCE(c.click_count, 0) as click_count FROM note n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT note_id, COUNT(*) as click_count FROM note_click_record
AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY note_id ) c ON n.id = c.note_id WHERE n.is_public = 1 ORDER BY click_count DESC, n.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
